description: An asset whose partition key is chosen while it runs, not before -- Airflow's PartitionedAtRuntime.

outputs.description: Registers the runtime-chosen key as a dynamic partition (if new) and reports a materialization of the catalog-facing partitioned asset for that key.

asset_key.description: The catalog-facing asset key (slash-delimited) that ends up partitioned by dynamic_partitions_name.
asset_key.label: Asset Key

dynamic_partitions_name.description: Name for the DynamicPartitionsDefinition backing asset_key.
dynamic_partitions_name.label: Dynamic Partitions Name

key_source.description: 'run_tag' | 'run_config' | 'callable_return' -- where the chosen partition key comes from.
key_source.label: Key Source

executor_asset_key.label: Executor Asset Key
executor_asset_key.description: Key (slash-delimited) for the real, unpartitioned executing asset that runs the callable. Defaults to '<asset_key>_runner'. Keep distinct from `asset_key` -- Dagster doesn't allow one AssetsDefinition to be both the unpartitioned runner and the dynamically-partitioned target.

key_run_tag.label: Key Run Tag
key_run_tag.description: key_source='run_tag' only (required then): the run tag name holding the chosen key.

key_config_field.label: Key Config Field
key_config_field.description: key_source='run_config' only (required then): the op config field name holding the chosen key.

kwargs.label: Kwargs
kwargs.description: Static keyword arguments passed to the callable.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: {name: upstream_asset_key}. Each entry's value is loaded via the IO manager and bound to a parameter of that name if the callable's signature declares one (TaskFlow-style) -- same shape as python_callable_asset's `inputs`.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

report_value_as_metadata.label: Report Value As Metadata
report_value_as_metadata.description: If true, the callable's returned payload is recorded as `value` metadata on the reported materialization (via dg.MetadataValue.text/json as appropriate) -- best-effort; non-JSON-serializable payloads are stringified. Set false to skip this if the payload is large or sensitive.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group name (applied to both the executor and the catalog-facing asset).

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description (applied to the catalog-facing asset).

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool (e.g. Airflow's `pool` -- a fixed number of slots shared across every asset/op using the same pool name). The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level (dagster.yaml's concurrency: pools:, or the Dagster+ UI), not here.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Fail the executing asset's step if the callable hasn't returned after this many seconds. Enforced via a background-thread wrapper -- the callable may continue running past the deadline (Python threads can't be forcibly killed); this bounds the step's wait, not the call itself.
